stakeholder.stakeholder_description: Fictional vehicle manufacturer who integrates the item and who owns the vehicle-level safety case, including the decision to isolate the pack on collision.

need_statement: When the item opens the contactors under power, the vehicle shall remain steerable and brakeable and the driver shall be told, in ordinary language and without a service manual, that the battery has been isolated and why.
rationale: This is the need that the master prompt's warning about mode-dependent safety behaviour makes unavoidable: disconnecting a battery during traction removes propulsion, so the reaction that satisfies the safety goal is itself a change in the vehicle's behaviour that a person has to live with. A driver who is cut off without an explanation will assume the worst and may attempt a restart sequence, which puts them back into contact with a pack the item has just isolated for a reason. The need is ranked second because it is the need most likely to be lost when the engineering is dominated by the reaction latency question.
